title: Introduction to Molecular Phylogenetic Reconstruction with the ETE3 Toolkit
author: Frank O Aylward
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qhydt7w

steps.title: Prepare Practice Data
steps.instruction: Clone the tutorial repository and navigate to the marker gene phylogenetics directory.

substeps.instruction: Verify the presence of the mystery protein file: `head mystery_protein.faa`

steps.title: Download and Inspect Reference Sequences
steps.instruction: Download the NarG marker protein sequences from the EggNOG database and perform basic quality control.

substeps.instruction: Calculate protein length statistics (mean, min, max, sstdev) using seqtk and datamash: `seqtk comp narg.faa | datamash mean 2 min 2 max 2 sstdev 2`

steps.title: Filter Proteins by Length
steps.instruction: Remove proteins that are more than two standard deviations shorter than the mean (cutoff: 755 amino acids) to improve alignment and inference.

substeps.instruction: Generate a list of proteins longer than 755 amino acids: `seqtk comp narg.faa | awk '$2>755' | cut -f 1 > narg.long_proteins.list`
Extract the filtered sequences into a new FASTA file: `seqtk subseq narg.faa narg.long_proteins.list > narg.long_proteins.faa`
Compare sequence counts before and after filtering: `grep -c '^>' narg.faa` and `grep -c '^>' narg.long_proteins.faa`

steps.title: De-replicate Reference Sequences
steps.instruction: Use CD-HIT to remove redundant sequences and retain only cluster representatives.

substeps.instruction: Run CD-HIT with default parameters (90% identity over 90% length): `cdhit -i narg.long_proteins.faa -o narg.nr.faa`
Compare sequence counts to determine the number of removed redundant sequences: `grep -c '^>' narg.long_proteins.faa` and `grep -c '^>' narg.nr.faa`

steps.title: Consolidate Sequences
steps.instruction: Combine the non-redundant reference sequences with the mystery protein sequence into a single input file.

steps.title: Reconstruct Phylogeny with ETE3
steps.instruction: Use the ETE3 toolkit to perform sequence alignment, trimming, and phylogenetic inference.

substeps.instruction: Run the build command: `ete3 build -a all_narg.faa -o narg_phylogeny -w standard_trimmed_fasttree --spname-delimiter -C 16`
Wait for the process to complete (approximately 5-10 minutes).
Locate the output directory `narg_phylogeny` and the specific workflow subdirectory containing the `.nwk` (tree) and `.fa` (alignment) files.
